title: Repo Rust Implementation and Taxonomy Tree
description: Give the repo product a clean domain-driven, implementation-neutral taxonomy tree, implement the whole repo product in Rust next to the Go implementation so both fulfil the same language-agnostic tests, and make the terminal dashboard use the Rust implementation by default. Coordinated from Claude Fable 5.1 with Opus 5 implementers and Sonnet 5 read-only explorers working alongside other concurrent fleets.
summary: Repo product restructured into 29 domain modules with Go and Rust twins under one language-agnostic test harness (25 owners, parity green, third-party oracles), the Rust semio binary carrying every verb plus the MCP server as the default for all IDE entry points and the terminal dashboard, Go selectable via SEMIO_REPO_IMPLEMENTATION=go. Details: 📓️closing-summary.md, 📓️audit-final.md.
